- A CH2 group next to the carbonyl
- A carbonyl group C=O
- A CH group in the vinyl portion (CH=)

2. The CH carbon in the isopropyl group = 1 signal
3. The CH2 carbon next to the carbonyl = 1 signal
4. The carbonyl carbon (C=O) = 1 signal
5. The CH carbon in the vinyl group = 1 signal
6. The terminal CH2 carbon in the vinyl group = 1 signal
